text:
This Joey Porter Jr. situation is just getting messier.

He’s showing up to practice, but this week we find out that he’s still part of what Mike McCarthy termed a “ramp-up period” to get back into shape and get reacquainted with what he’s supposed to be doing defensively.

And now he’s apparently limited again with a back injury.

Okay...

So Joey still doesn’t have a contract.

He’s attempting to ramp things up physically.

He’s officially on the injury report with a back issue.

And the Steelers are expecting to somehow pay him AND have him ready to play?

This is just a messy situation, man.

And let’s not ignore the timing here, either.

As he’s getting a contract offer that’s apparently not close to what he wants, now he’s dealing with a back injury again and is limited in practice.

At this point, I’m going to be shocked if Joey Porter Jr. is in uniform on Sunday.

If Baylor and BA want to play this game I have no problem with that. But go play a national schedule with other like minded programs instead of beating up on programs that have no interest in paying players.

text:
It Isn’t That You’re Wrong; It’s That You Are Insufferable

     This is the second time inside of a 3-month timeframe that I have felt compelled to tell the diehard pro-gen AI Bros and Hoes to tone it the fuck down. Since they broadly don’t seem capable of civility in any sense of the word, I’ll turn to an approach that they may understand a bit better- put a fucking sock in it.
     The majority of you have become just as insufferable, if not more so, than the whining, whinging, hardcore anti-AI crowd who you so love to clown upon, the digital equivalent of little Prince/King Jauffre from Game of Thrones, and I’d kind of like to see some of you choke to death like he did, eyes goggling out of your heads as your lungs fill with your own liquified tongues and throats. 
     “Whoa, kind of harsh, Josh,” I imagine some might say. Well, tough shit, I would reply. These dickbags like to claim they don’t care anymore what their opposition says, so why offer them decency or softened language, when it doesn’t mean a goddamned thing to them? They’re so ‘above it all’, so fuck the niceties. 
     I’ve tried explaining that I understand that many of them have been under absolutely vicious hostility and pressure from unhinged anti-AI absolutists, and that slightly more empathetic approach got me where, exactly? Aiming for nuance or subtlety gets you nowhere with this crowd, especially when you’re a relative non-entity like I am, so using the megaphone of vitriol starts to look like the only resort left to me. In that vein:
     Fuck Leaflit. Fuck Ember Paradox. To hell with every one of these “OnLy ReSuLtS mAtTeR”, soulless, spiritless, careless GDP-first, Line Go Up, productivity worshipping, inhuman heretics who have decided that only their perspectives are worthy of getting a hearing and holding the floor. Most of them seem to have all of the technical skill in the world, and bully for them, but they also seem to have zero ability to appreciate history or a sense of shared humanity.
     They are lovely little worker drones who will happily declare entire swatches of their fellow humans ‘obsolete’ and whistle Dixie past the graveyard as they skip away from the wreckage left in their wakes. “Get with the times,” they bark. “No one cares how long it took you to acquire these skills, they want results, now!”
     Human beings and their lives beyond their labor value to the market or employers are not line items on a spreadsheet, you feckless cunts! Is it really any wonder that most of these people are uncoupled and childless? Who would want to conceive and raise a kid with such mechanistic freaks of nature? This goes double for the blue-haired slime girl, since she seems to adore telling everyone else that they need to have kids, and she doesn’t seem capable of maintaining a close interpersonal relationship beyond the one she has with her mother. Yes, that’s a personal dig, at this point, she fucking deserves it; you want to demand other people do Thing X so loudly, then lead by example, retard.
     One Carrington Event, and most of these people will become worthless noise holes in faces that deserve a middle finger, a kick in the teeth, and the cold comfort of their own miserable, lonesome company. I almost pray for it at some points when reading/listening to these people.
     “Wagon builders and buggy makers Reeee’d about the automobile too, suck it up, history has no place for losers,” they quip with enough snark to fuel John Oliver for the next decade. Hey, fuck stick, did you know that Henry Ford hired close to 400k cabinet makers, buggy makers, wagoneers and other woodworkers to learn and work in his early shops? The first of his assembly plants was set up in a former woodshop as homage to the roots of transportation! He and his early competitors established ‘trade homes’, communal bunkhouses for displaced artisans to live while they learned assembly work and transitioned to the new labor environment.
     These heavy-handed pro-Gen AI dickheads are way more ‘adapt or die’ than those trailblazers they always seem to love comparing themselves and their efforts to. The whole ‘Automotive Analogy’ falls flat on its ass with even a modicum of examination, so they can fuck off with that.
      Another one they love to trot out and lean into is photography. They’ll point out that the arrival of photography didn’t eliminate visual artists, and they are absolutely correct there. Thank God for people still wanting art that isn’t just documentation of our tangible world. Additionally, a quick question: who did early photographers turn to for analysis and critique of their captured images? Oh, right: artists. Who were the first folks to get instruction and really master the use of the tools of photography in the main? Oh, right: artists. 
     There is always going to be hesitation and skepticism when a new toolset or technology is introduced, a desire to ask for restraint when an altogether foreign or alien way of doing things is presented for consideration. Questions of cost, of by-products, of side effects are natural, human inquiries to pose. Defending one’s known methodology and way of life is a very human impulse. 
     Every time a new technique or technology has been introduced, historically, the creators and early adopters of them have reached out a hand in invitation. With the Gen-AI boosters, there is no extended hand, but rather, middle fingers, insults and invective so laced with nuclear hate and smug superiority that folks drawing near should have Geiger Counters handy.
     It’s generally not advised to engage with those folks in anger, because they find your upset amusing, like most terminally online tech-folk and/or trolls. Certainly I shouldn’t probably be so overtly hostile; it isn’t my work or Art these people are so intent on rendering meaningless right now. They don’t have to; they already cheered that on when ChatGPT and Grok started putting together prompt texts to shunt human efforts aside. 
     They don’t care about you, or me, or any other traditional Artist who has reservations about these supposed technological marvels. Most of them treat life as a game, and their only interest is in winning. But life is not a game; there is no leaderboard, no high score that gets recorded forever. Life is a myriad of stories, an infinitely expanding library of tales written by doing the living itself.
     Well, something like that, anyway. Probably a bad analogy on my part here. Does it matter, though? None of the people this is aimed at are going to read or hear this anyway; they are much-beloved online figures, and I’m an irrelevant anachronism in many ways, hand-writing the draft of this script in a pocket notebook purchased at the local Dollar Tree, scribbling during my breaks at work at my normie job.
     In short, exactly the sort of person whose view counts or livestream donations they want, but whose perspectives and opinions don’t mean shit to them.
     Fuck them.
     I had much nastier things to say to a couple of them, but what’s the point? This wasn’t made with their precious AI, so they wouldn’t notice anyhow.
